Title: The Missing Thrift Store Gem
Description: While shopping at her favorite thrift store in Hawthorn Cove Daphne discovers a rare vintage brooch has gone missing. The store owner suspects an insider. Daphne teams up with Sheriff Beau to investigate the staff and uncover a heartwarming twist.

Title: Casino Night Conspiracy
Description: Daphne's lucky streak at the casino is interrupted when she witnesses a high-stakes card game that turns suspicious. A wealthy tourist claims someone cheated him out of a fortune. With Lakota's sharp mind and MacKenzie's observant eye they unravel an elaborate scheme.

Title: The Art Gallery Forgery
Description: A prestigious art gallery in town discovers one of its paintings might be a forgery worth thousands. Daphne's keen eye for detail and Hayley's knowledge of art history combine to expose the truth. A web of deception involving the gallery owner and a desperate artist unfolds.

Title: The Poisoned Recipe
Description: A local cooking competition turns deadly when a contestant becomes ill. Daphne suspects foul play when she recognizes the symptoms from an old case. Hudson's innocent questions lead to the crucial breakthrough in this culinary mystery.

Title: The Mayor's Missing Diamond
Description: When the mayor's priceless diamond goes missing from a locked vault suspicion falls on several staff members. Daphne must navigate political pressure and family dynamics when Hayley's colleague becomes a suspect. MacKenzie provides tech-savvy solutions to trace the diamond.
